events.name: SIGNAL_UPDATED
events.description: The signal-detection state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: signal detection, SDT, d prime, criterion, hit rate, false alarm, ROC point, sensitivity, response bias

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: SET_CRITERION
events.description: Learner dragged the decision criterion; the theoretical hit and false-alarm rates recompute and the empirical counters re-anchor to zero.

events.name: RUN_TRIALS
events.description: Ran a batch of simulated detection trials at the configured base rate — each trial draws evidence from the noise or signal+noise distribution and scores a hit or false alarm against the criterion.

events.name: RESET
events.description: Learner reset the instrument — criterion, theoretical rates, and empirical counters return to their starting values.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Base Rate
overridableConfigKeys.description: Probability that a simulated trial actually contains a signal — governs the empirical hit/false-alarm mix in RUN_TRIALS.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: base rate, signal prevalence, prior probability, signal probability

overridableConfigKeys.label: Criterion
overridableConfigKeys.description: Initial decision threshold on the evidence axis; evidence above it triggers a 'signal present' response. Hit rate is Φ(d′ − c), false-alarm rate Φ(−c).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: decision criterion, response bias, threshold, beta, cutoff

overridableConfigKeys.label: Criterion Color
overridableConfigKeys.description: Color of the criterion line and marker.

overridableConfigKeys.label: d′ (Sensitivity)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Separation between the noise and signal+noise distributions, in standard deviations — the learner's sensitivity to the signal.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: d prime, sensitivity, discriminability, signal strength, detectability

overridableConfigKeys.label: Interactive
overridableConfigKeys.description: Enable pointer interaction on the canvas.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Match Mode
overridableConfigKeys.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Noise Curve Color
overridableConfigKeys.description: Color of the noise distribution curve.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Signal Curve Color
overridableConfigKeys.description: Color of the signal+noise distribution curve.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Trials Per Run
overridableConfigKeys.description: Simulated detection trials per RUN_TRIALS click.
